# Da Ollys Integrated Services Ltd
> Elite logistics, haulage, property relocation, luxury vehicle rentals, private jet charters, and global travel consulting. Based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.

## Core services
- [International & Local Travel Bookings](https://www.daollysintegratedservicesltd.com/services/travels): Flights, visas, hotels, tour packages, work & relocation programs
- [Logistics & Dispatch Service](https://www.daollysintegratedservicesltd.com/services/deliveries): Same-day courier, parcel delivery in Port Harcourt
- [Luxury Rentals](https://www.daollysintegratedservicesltd.com/services/luxury-rentals): Premium chauffeur-driven vehicles, wedding fleets, private jet charters
- [Property Movement & Relocation](https://www.daollysintegratedservicesltd.com/services/property-movement): Residential & office relocation, interstate & international moves
- [Haulage Services](https://www.daollysintegratedservicesltd.com/services/haulage): Heavy-duty transport, industrial logistics, bulk cargo movement
